about.title: A studio built around one idea: entertainment matters
about.intro: Jolly Panda Studio started with a simple belief — the software behind games, products and brands should be as enjoyable as the entertainment it supports. That belief still shapes everything we build.

mission.title: Mission
mission.desc: To design and build entertainment-first digital products — games, websites and software — that people genuinely enjoy using, not just tolerate.

vision.title: Vision
vision.desc: To become a studio developers, founders and other studios think of first when a project needs both craft and personality.

valuesIntro.title: Values
valuesIntro.desc: Four principles guide every decision, from the first sketch to the final release. You'll see them below.

entertainment.title: Entertainment-First Philosophy
entertainment.desc: Before we ask if something works, we ask if it's enjoyable. Delight is a requirement, not a bonus feature.

craft.title: Real Craft
craft.desc: We sweat details most teams skip — motion timing, spacing, copy tone — because those details are the experience.

honesty.title: Straight Talk
honesty.desc: We tell clients what a project actually needs, even when it's not what they expected to hear.

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.desc: Every project has a name attached to it on our team. Nothing ships without someone standing behind it.

process.title: Our creative development process
process.subtitle: A straightforward path from idea to launch, kept flexible enough for the project to surprise us.

discover.title: Discover
discover.desc: Understand the goal, the audience and what "success" actually looks like.

design.title: Design
design.desc: Explore concepts and visual direction until one feels unmistakably right.

build.title: Build
build.desc: Develop in focused iterations, testing early and often along the way.

launch.title: Launch & Support
launch.desc: Ship it, watch how people use it, and keep improving from there.

tech.title: Modern technologies we build with
tech.subtitle: We pick tools for the project at hand rather than defaulting to the same stack every time.

originals.title: Original Titles
originals.desc: Growing beyond client work into original games we design and publish ourselves.

team.title: A Bigger Bamboo Grove
team.desc: Bringing on more designers and engineers who care about craft as much as we do.

community.title: Community First
community.desc: Opening up more of our process — a blog, a portfolio, and eventually a place to work with us directly.
